opportunities.name: Research topic to paper note
opportunities.description: For a topic and year, find the top matching arXiv paper via Advanced Search, confirm its citation count on Semantic Scholar, and record a summary line in the Notes app.
steps: Enter the topic in the title search term
Select Specific year and enter the year
Click Search and open the top result
Search the title on Semantic Scholar and open the result
Read the first author and citation count
In Notes, add a line: topic (year): title by author, N citations

instances.values: retrieval augmented generation, cs, 2023 -> RIGHT paper, 11 citations
protein structure diffusion, q-bio, 2024 -> Accelerating Inference in Molecular Diffusion Models, 7 citations
graph neural networks traffic forecasting, cs, year entry started but not completed

opportunities.name: Case law to statute note
opportunities.description: Look up a US court case on CourtListener, then look up the key statute on Cornell LII, and note the case citation with the statute in Notes.
steps: Type the case name in the CourtListener search box and press Enter
Open the matching case result and read the citation and date
Open Cornell LII and search the statute citation
In Notes, add a line: case: citation, decided date. See statute (title)

instances.values: Miranda v. Arizona; only the CourtListener search/open part was done
